items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember a fellow named Joe Gabriel from Thibodeau? He had a band? [INTERVIEWEE] Not from Thibodeau. I don't know about Thibodeau.

ctx.x: When he was born? Yeah. Well, it was a long time before he was born, too. Yeah. But I was young and I sang in the choir. I sang the choir, it had been over 80 years ago.
Remember a fellow named Joe Gabriel from Thibodeau? He had a band?
Not from Thibodeau. I don't know about Thibodeau. I lived near the Fodenville.
